_comment: Pairs of lemmas that must never be offered against each other in a contextual item. Read rather than derived: each pair below was found by reading the shipped bank, and each is a case where the frame the pack builds around one of them accepts the other just as naturally. Consulted by scripts/content/build_level_test.mjs when it draws distractors, and by scripts/level-test-ambiguity-qa.mjs when it reads the bank back. Symmetric — the order in a pair carries no meaning.
_why: The builder's other guards are evidence: a shared gloss word, a shared category, a recorded synonym, a shared argument in the two examples' own sentences. These pairs pass every one of those and still produce two right answers, because what they share is a selectional class that nothing in the pack records — 결과 accepts both 얻다 and 날리다, 생각 accepts 지지하다 and 분석하다 and 품다. Generality is a fact about the language, not about the pack, so this is the judgement written down, in the same spirit as GENERAL_VERBS.
_review: Every pair was confirmed by composing both sentences and reading them. docs/AMBIGUITY_LEDGER.md carries the sentence, the two readings, and the verdict.

pairs.why: 공부를 해요 and 공부를 사랑해요 are both ordinary
결과를 얻다 and 결과를 날리다 are both idiomatic, and opposite
지난 일을 조사하다 is as ordinary as 돌아보다
지난 일을 자랑하다 fits the same frame
생각을 분석하다 is at least as common
생각을 품다 is a fixed collocation
색을 고려하다 is ordinary
색을 선별하다 is ordinary
시간을 기록하다 fits the same object
상황을 넘어서고 있어요 is ordinary
일을 이끌다 and 일을 담당하다 are near-interchangeable here
경찰이 그를 비난했어요 is an ordinary sentence
경찰이 그 사람을 고용했어요 fits the frame
방법을 자랑하다 fits the same object
음식을 치우다 is ordinary and unrelated in meaning
환경을 가늠하다 fits the frame
an arithmetic frame accepts either operation
그 말이 저를 겨냥했어요 is as ordinary as 일깨웠어요
생각을 선호하다 is as ordinary as 지지하다
경찰이 그를 협박했어요 fits the frame exactly
역사 이야기 is as ordinary a compound as 유령 이야기
탄생 소식 is a fixed collocation
마무리 연습 is a real compound
거래 정보 is an ordinary compound
both are adverbs that fit a bare adverbial slot — writing Hangul every day and writing a little of it are both ordinary
